+def complete_snapshot_id(
+    ctx: click.Context,
+    param: click.Parameter,
+    incomplete: str,
+) -> Iterable[str]:
+    try:
+        self: Monitor = current_monitor.get()
+    except LookupError:
+        return []
+    return [
+        str(snapshot.id)
+        for snapshot in self.list_snapshots()
+        if str(snapshot.id).startswith(incomplete)
+    ][:10]
+
+
+def complete_snapshot_task_id(
+    ctx: click.Context,
+    param: click.Parameter,
+    incomplete: str,
+) -> Iterable[str]:
+    try:
+        self: Monitor = current_monitor.get()
+    except LookupError:
+        return []
+    # The preceding positional argument is the snapshot ID.
+    snapshot_id = ctx.params.get("snapshot_id")
+    if snapshot_id is None and ctx.protected_args:
+        snapshot_id = ctx.protected_args[-1]
+    if snapshot_id is None:
+        return []
+    try:
+        return [
+            task_id
+            for task_id in (
+                info.task_id
+                for info in self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id)
+            )
+            if task_id.startswith(incomplete)
+        ][:10]
+    except KeyError:
+        return []
